title: Coast, day
comment: Southern Cove and the beaches by day. A dorian, but every chord avoids the sixth degree (f#), so coast_night (A aeolian, same chords, same 2-bar rhythm) can crossfade into it note for note. Open, high voicings: the 200-600 Hz band is left thin for the surf sound effect (step 5.5). Bar = 4 s, like every region track.

layers.comment: the harmonic bed, voiced above g3; always on while on the coast
breaths of filtered noise in uneven groups: the motion of waves, not their sound; on by day, slower at night
light on water: high, sparse plucks through a long delay; the layer that carries the track on a phone speaker
a soft root under each chord, never busy; can drop out when the surf effect is loud
layers.pattern: <a2 g2 c3 a2 d3 g2 c3 e2>/2

layers.comment: a far-off buoy bell, twice a loop: the only sign of the outside world
